title: Reference images and camera matching in Blender

queue.claim: Blender lens shift (shift_x/shift_y) is in units of the sensor-fit dimension: width under HORIZONTAL fit, larger dimension under AUTO. If true, face3d to_blender_camera (HORIZONTAL fit, divides by max(W,H)) mis-sets shift for portrait-orientation photos.
queue.query: Blender camera shift_x units sensor fit horizontal "viewfac" BKE_camera_params_compute_viewplane shift

queue.claim: Horizontal visible iris diameter is ~11.7 ± 0.5 mm across adults (figure used by Google MediaPipe Iris for metric depth estimation).
queue.query: MediaPipe Iris horizontal iris diameter 11.7 mm depth estimation

queue.claim: Adult interpupillary distance mean ~63 mm, SD ~3.5-4 mm, most adults 50-75 mm (Dodgson 2004).
queue.query: Dodgson 2004 variation and extrema of human interpupillary distance mean standard deviation

queue.claim: Selfie-distance photos (~30 cm) increase apparent nasal base width by roughly 30% relative to ~1.5 m (Ward, Ward, Fried, Paskhover, JAMA Facial Plastic Surgery 2018).
